title: Who approves a GPU-stack change?

scenes.heading: A GPU stack change reaches review
scenes.sub: Start with the proposed rollout steps.
voice: Your team wants to upgrade the GPU stack while workloads are running.
The Operator asks AICR to assess the proposed steps before it acts on them.
scenes.result: Review the plan before it starts

scenes.heading: Three paths through the gate
scenes.sub: The step type and risk set the policy.
voice: A safe chart upgrade without a CRD change can proceed without approval.
Installs and changes with uncertain impact need approval, and a blocked upgrade never advances.

scenes.heading: A second person reviews the plan
voice: An authorized approver reviews the recorded steps, including any manual requirements.
Approval ties the plan to its starting inventory and deadline, and the author cannot approve their own change.

scenes.heading: The starting point changed
voice: If the release inventory drifts after approval, the Operator stalls before it applies the next change.
The team can investigate the difference and decide how to proceed.

viewer: GPU platform owners and rollout approvers
payoff: Decide which transitions need a second person and see an approved rollout stall if its starting state changes.
